summary: ITER205 / ITER204-B Entity Navigation Layer tested end-to-end. Backend: 12/12 pytest pass (4 composite detail endpoints + embassy real-count fix + studio-library saved flag integration). Frontend: Material, Designer detail pages render correctly with required testids and Save buttons; Brand Embassy real product_count for Essentials confirmed via backend; however the Collection Detail page renders 'Collezione non trovata' when reached through Brand Embassy → Essentials click flow (backend API for the SAME ids returns 200 with 123 products), indicating a frontend routing/param-extraction bug in CollectionDetailPage. Studio Library save flow from designer page could not be confirmed (designer not visible on /studio-library after save action, while ARBI Brand correctly persists).

minor.issue: Unknown material names (e.g. '__definitely_unknown_material_xyz__') return 200 with empty payload instead of 404; consider returning 404 when neither canonical, detected, nor any product matches.

ui_bugs.issue: When navigating via Brand Embassy → Essentials card click the page renders 'Collezione non trovata' even though the underlying GET /api/knowledge/brands/{brandId}/collections/{collectionId} returns 200 with 123 products for the same ids. Likely a frontend param-extraction / fetch wiring issue in CollectionDetailPage.jsx (e.g. swapped useParams keys, missing await, or wrong API client method). Backend is healthy.

After clicking [data-testid='designer-save-to-library'] (Marco Acerbis) and navigating to /studio-library, the saved designer does not appear in the grid. The Save button does flip to 'In Library' on the designer page (suggesting at least optimistic UI worked), but persistence/listing on Studio Library was not confirmed.

integration_issues.issue: Click navigation reaches /inspirations/brands/:brandId/collections/:collectionId but the detail page shows 'Collezione non trovata'. Backend confirmed healthy with same ids.

issues: Many missing it-IT i18n keys (entity.material.brands_label/collections_label/products_label/no_*_title/no_*; entity.designer.bio_pending/brands_label/collections_label/products_label/no_*) — fallbacks render but localization layer incomplete.
Residual 'Cannot update a component while rendering a different component' React warning fires on multiple mounts (already flagged in ITER204).

action_items: FIX (HIGH): CollectionDetailPage.jsx — page renders 'Collezione non trovata' though the backend endpoint returns 200 for the test ids (ab1399d7-… / 03c481c4-…). Verify useParams key names (brandId, collectionId), the entityNavigationApi.js method, and how 404/error states are derived from the response.

FIX (MEDIUM): Investigate why a saved designer (entity_type=designer) is not showing up in /studio-library grid even though the Save button reflects 'In Library' state. Possible cache/refetch issue on the Studio Library list, or the studio_library_items entry isn't being created/looked up with the right entity_id when source isn't 'brand_atlas'.
ADD missing it-IT i18n keys for entity.material.* and entity.designer.* groups (full list in design_issues).
(Optional) Make GET /api/knowledge/materials/{name} return 404 when there is no canonical, no detected entity, and no matching products.
critical_code_review_comments: Composite endpoints are well-structured and tenant-scoped via get_tenant_context.
Material endpoint correctly accepts both UUID and name (case-insensitive) with sensible fallback logic.
saved flag wiring through _is_saved + studio_library_items works as verified by the integration test.
Material endpoint's broad product scan (limit 2000, python filter) is fine for current data sizes but is O(n) and may need an index on materials_text or a GIN on materials for scale.
Frontend collection detail rendering 404 against a healthy backend is the most important bug to fix in this iteration.

success_rate.frontend: ~60% (Material, Designer, Embassy load OK with correct testids; Collection Detail navigation broken; Studio Library save→list flow not confirmed)

seed_data_creation: Backend test creates and cleans up a studio_library_items entry for entity_type=designer / entity_id=fa5ede59-… (source_type=brand_atlas). The earlier ITER204 ARBI brand save (1 row) remains in the Studio Library and is visible in /studio-library.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_iter205_entity_navigation.py — 12 tests, all green on the preview URL in ~20s. Login token via response.json()['session']['access_token']. Studio Library POST requires source_type in: ['academy','brand_atlas','case_study','editorial','import','manual','market_insight'] or null — 'knowledge_graph' is NOT accepted. When E1 fixes CollectionDetailPage, re-run a Playwright pass: login → /inspirations/brands/ab1399d7-…-/collections/03c481c4-…- and assert data-testid='collection-detail-page' renders, counts show 123, and Save button works.
rca of the issue: Frontend CollectionDetailPage shows 'Collezione non trovata' on click-through despite backend returning 200 for the same brand/collection ids. Most likely causes (to verify in code): (a) useParams() destructuring uses wrong key (e.g. :collection_id vs :collectionId mismatch with the route), (b) entityNavigationApi method called with swapped args (brandId/collectionId), or (c) response error handling treats any non-200 from a sibling call (e.g. saved-flag prefetch) as full-page 404. Reproduction: login as admin, open /inspirations/brands/ab1399d7-ab6a-498e-8c4f-bc36af69e182, click the Essentials collection card. Mitigation: align useParams keys with App.js route, ensure entityNavigationApi.getCollectionDetail(brandId, collectionId) wraps the correct path, and gate the 404 view on the actual collection response only.
